g.text: TUBING CONVEYOR
Front Side
Lifts
Facilities

text.tspan: The Tech Shop at Mount Kato is located on the main
floor of the chalet, towards the east end of the building.
It offers a wide range of services, including equipment
tuning, waxing, and repairs. In addition, the Tech Shop
carries a variety of accessories such as helmets,
goggles, gloves, and many other items essential for a
great day on the slopes.
The lesson bell at Mount Kato is located in a bell tower
at the base of the Little Beaver and Timberwolf trails,
near Lift #4. This is where instructors will gather their
students at the start of each lesson.
If you have trouble finding the bell tower, don't hesitate
to ask any staff member for assistance. They will be
happy to direct you to the correct location.
The Ski Patrol Aid Room at Mount Kato is located in the
first building you encounter, right in front of Lift #1.
It is conveniently situated next to the seasonal lockers
and is easily identifiable by signage indicating "Ski
Patrol." If you are injured or need assistance, please do
not hesitate to visit the Ski Patrol Aid Room for help.
The Learning Center at Mount Kato is conveniently
located on the first floor of the chalet, providing easy
access for all guests. This dedicated space offers a
welcoming environment for beginners and those
looking to improve their skiing or snowboarding skills.
The Learning Center provides a variety of programs and
lessons for all ages and abilities, taught by experienced
and certified instructors.
The Learning Center at Mount Kato is conveniently
located on the first floor of the chalet, providing easy
access for all guests. This dedicated space offers a
welcoming environment for beginners and those
looking to improve their skiing or snowboarding skills.
The Learning Center provides a variety of programs and
lessons for all ages and abilities, taught by experienced
and certified instructors.
The Rental shop is located just east of the Chalet, two
buildings down from The Guest Services office. Enter
the rental bulding at the first door on the southwest
corner of the rental building (the side facing the hill).
There are counters available to fill out your rental forms.
There is also a scale and ruler available to help those
that don’t know their height or weight.
The Guest Services office at Mount Kato is located in
the same office as the Ticket Windows.
Use the entrence at the side of the building facing the
slopes.
20461 State Hwy 66, Mankato, MN 56001.
The phone number for the Guest Services office is
Lift Tickets, Equipment Rental Forms & Snow Tubing
Passes are all available at the ticket windows on east
side of the Guest Services Building.
Tickets and Passses can also be purchased online.
Big Bear, accessed by Lift Seven, is an exhilarating
advanced run that challenges skiers and snowboarders
with its steep pitches and varied terrain. This thrilling
trail winds through a mix of open slopes and tree-lined
sections, demanding precise turns and confident
control. As you descend, you'll be rewarded with
breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. Big
Bear is a must-try for experienced thrill-seekers looking
to push their limits and conquer a demanding yet
rewarding run.
An expert-only trail that delivers a thrilling rush of
adrenaline. This steep, narrow chute plunges down from
Big Bear, demanding precise control and confidence.
This exhilarating trail is not for the faint of heart and
should only be attempted by experienced skiers and
snowboarders seeking a true test of their skills.
Little Crow is the easiest way down from lift seven,
offering a gentle and wide path for intermediate skiers
and snowboarders. This well-groomed trail features a
gradual descent with minimal elevation changes,
allowing for a relaxed and enjoyable glide through a
scenic wooded landscape. Whether you're practicing
your skills or simply prefer a slower pace, Little Crow
provides a welcoming and stress-free experience
for everyone.
Sleepy Hollow is Mount Kato's longest and easiest trail,
offering a leisurely and scenic descent for skiers and
snowboarders of all levels. This gentle, winding trail
meanders through a picturesque wooded landscape,
with wide, well-groomed slopes and minimal elevation
changes. Whether you're a beginner finding your snow
legs or a seasoned enthusiast seeking a relaxing run,
Sleepy Hollow provides a tranquil and enjoyable
experience for everyone.
Birch Coulee is a wide, gentle slope perfect for beginner
skiers and snowboarders to practice their skills and
build confidence. This well-groomed trail offers a relax
ing descent through a scenic birch forest, with ample
space to turn and control your speed. It's a great place
to enjoy the valley views and take in the fresh air while
honing your abilities on the snow.
Birch Pass is a short, beginner-friendly connecting trail
linking the top of lift 6 to Birch Coulee.
This well-groomed path is ideal for those seeking
a relaxing glide through a scenic wooded landscape.
Sleepy Creek Cutoff offers intermediate skiers a scenic
and enjoyable descent from the top of lift six. Whether
you're looking for a quick run or a longer journey, Sleepy
Creek Cutoff is a great addition to your Mount Kato
experience.
Little Forest: Offering intermediate skiers a delightful
experience with its rolling terrain and scenic views.
As you descend, you'll encounter gentle slopes and
moderate pitches, perfect for practicing your turns
and building confidence. Whether you're cruising
down the slopes or hitting the park, Little Forest
is sure to leave you smiling.

g.text: Big Hawk Ridge: A scenic cruise with breathtaking
views. This popular intermediate trail is a favorite
among Mount Kato guests for its gentle slopes and
stunning vistas of the Blue Earth River Valley. A perfect
choice for those looking to enjoy a relaxing run while
taking in the beauty of the surrounding landscape.
Sundance Terrain Park: Show off your freestyle skills on
our premier park trail. This popular spot boasts a variety
of features for all levels, but can get quite busy. If you're
new to terrain parks or prefer a more relaxed experi
ence, we recommend exploring our smaller progression
parks, usually located at the top of Sleepy Hollow
and/or Birch Coulee. Please note that rental equipment
is prohibited in all terrain parks.
Eagle Ridge: An intermediate trail with a hidden
surprise. Similar to Wild Deer, Eagle Ridge offers a
slightly steeper challenge than other blue runs at Mount
Kato. Stay skiers left for a more gradual descent, or test
your skills on the short, steep section right in the middle
for an extra thrill. This versatile trail offers options for
intermediates looking to push their limits.
Wild Deer: An intermediate trail that takes it up a notch.
A bit steeper than most blue runs at Mount Kato, Wild
Deer is the perfect stepping stone for intermediate
skiers ready to challenge themselves. Enjoy the thrill of
a slightly steeper descent while still feeling confident on
familiar terrain.
Little Brave: A hidden gem for the fearless.
Tucked under Lift One, Little Brave is a steep and fast
trail that challenges even the most experienced skiers
and snowboarders. This hidden gem is a local favorite,
especially after a fresh snowfall.
Brave Chute: Tucked between the trees and Lift Two,
this steep, adrenaline-pumping chute is a favorite
among Mount Kato's thrill-seekers. Test your skills and
show off your advanced abilities on this challenging
descent.
Big Brave: A thrilling challenge for the fearless. This
steep run, accessible from Lifts One, Two, and Three at
Mount Kato, is a favorite among those who crave adren
aline. Navigate the exhilarating terrain and test your
skills on one of Mount Kato's most exciting descents.
Wolf Ridge: Test your limits on this thrilling intermediate
run. Known for its challenging race course, Wolf Ridge
is a fast, exciting descent that will get your heart
pumping.
Wolf Chute: Short, steep, and exhilarating.
This narrow chute offers a quick shot of adrenaline for
thrill-seekers. Be prepared for a challenging descent
that will put your skills to the test.
Timberwolf Trail: Your gentle path down the mountain.
A favorite for all levels, Timberwolf Trail winds its way
down from the top of the mountain, offering stunning
scenery and a smooth, relaxing descent. Skiers right
after the big turn, you'll find access to the Little Beaver
beginner area, making Timberwolf an excellent option
for families and groups of varying abilities.
Little Beaver Learning Area: Your perfect starting point
on the slopes. Designed with beginners in mind, Little
Beaver is a gentle, wide run offering a safe and fun
environment to learn and practice skiing or
snowboarding. Serviced by Lift Four, the dedicated
learning area also features the SunKid conveyor lift for
easy access, and is home to most beginner lessons.
With its gradual slope and supportive atmosphere, Little
Beaver is the ideal place to build confidence and
develop your skills.
Get ready to laugh and scream with delight!
Our tubing park offers four thrilling lanes of downhill
fun. Zoom down the slope on a specially designed tube
and then ride the conveyor lift effortlessly back to the
top. As the sun sets, experience the magic of Glow
Tubing, where colorful lights transform the park into a
winter wonderland.
Lift Eight: As our longest lift, Eight offers breathtaking
views and convenient access to the front side and the
chalet. Accessible from all back trails, it's the primary
route back to the main area. If Eight is not running,
Lift Five can get you back via Sleepy Creek Cutoff from
Lift Six or Little Crow from Lift Seven.
For the easiest descent, take the Timberwolf Trail.
Lift Seven: Your sun-soaked sanctuary for afternoon
adventures. A favorite among regulars, Lift Seven offers
prime conditions when shadows descend on the front
side. With stunning sunsets and access to Little Crow,
Tommahawk Chute, and Big Bear, this lift is perfect for
experienced riders seeking thrilling challenges.
Please note, there are no easy trails from the top, so it's
best suited for those who have mastered the basics.
Lift Six: Your gateway to the heart of Mount Kato's
intermediate terrain. Explore the scenic Big Hawk Ridge,
Little Forest, and Sleepy Creek Cutoff trails, or access
Birch Coulee through Birch Pass.
While there are no beginner runs that extend to the
bottom, Big Hawk Ridge offers a gentle introduction to
intermediate terrain and is beloved by many regulars.
Lift Five: Located at the base of Birch Coulee and Little
Crow, and halfway down Sleepy Hollow, Lift Five
provides easy access to both trails. It's also one of two
lifts that will transport you back to the front side,
making it a valuable resource for navigating the
mountain.
Lift Four: Your first step to becoming a confident skier
or snowboarder. This two-seater lift serves the
dedicated learning area, where most beginner lessons
take place. Enjoy the gentle slopes of Little Beaver
beginner run as you hone your skills.
Lift Three: Accesses the southeastern front trails, easy
back side access through Sleepy Hollow, and the
thrilling Wolf Ridge race course. This quad is a
favorite for experienced riders and racers alike.
For a relaxing descent, take the Timberwolf Trail.
If you're looking for acces to our back side trails,
this lift offers the most convenient access.
Lift Two: Your primary access to the front side trails,
back side, and all the best terrain. This quad is the most
popular lift on the mountain, providing quick access to a
variety of trails. For a gentle descent from the top, the
Timberwolf Trail is your go-to option.
Lift One: Your gateway to our front side trails, backside
access, and the main terrain park on Sundace. This
two-seater is the quickest route to the park and offers
stunning views. For an easy descent from the top, take
Timberwolf Trail.
SunKid Conveyor Lift: Your first step on the snow. Not
quite ready for the chairlifts? No worries! Our SunKid
conveyor lift is the perfect starting point for those new
to skiing and snowboarding. It's ideal for our Kato Minis
program and anyone else embarking on their winter
sports journey. Located in the heart of our learning area
on Little Beaver, our main beginner run, the SunKid
makes learning a breeze.
Get ready to laugh and scream with delight!
Our tubing park offers four thrilling lanes of downhill
fun. Zoom down the slope on a specially designed tube
and then ride the conveyor lift effortlessly back to the
top. As the sun sets, experience the magic of Glow
